original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read Model section 1 of the three-register bound and identify the exact excluded free operations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: First compare the alphabet, role count and length with the fully replayed #1974 census and #2027 mixed-root tariff. Identify a changed premise and a legal native implementation; then price one smallest completed instance before searching larger words.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.
Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: Prove a second-order obstruction for PR4953's fixed seven-call J/P_s/D_s pattern on three dirty roles, with arbitrary odd-denominator rank-one frames, per-call per-role PBQ conjugations and all orders. This includes every S3 x S3 twist assignment requested in its handoff. The full two-sided register model remains open.
scope_change_reason: Handoff-first selection: PR4953 Open next question 1 explicitly requests the mod-I^3 test. The new obligation is action on arbitrary dirty degree-one inputs, beyond the covered first-order screen and exact enumeration of one twist assignment.
bottleneck_link: A favorable formal seven-call pattern could change the bit primitive's paid bill. This scoped obstruction rules out that pattern before a larger twist search; it supplies neither a native implementation nor a cost-free physical twist.
stop_rule: Stop after the fixed-pattern written proof, exact quotient/group-action checks and publication. No broader alphabet census, new selected kappa, or supplier-admission replay.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the quantified obstruction. verify.py checks 11,664 reduced permutation-twist cancellation cases, all 511 nonzero linear-form multiplication maps, the explicit dirty residual, 110 finite-group oracle comparisons, the 165-vector direct positive control, and semantic rejection controls. Author-checked, not independent human review.
author: Krzysztof Wójt / krzysztofwojt
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for proof, implementation and verification; a Luna supporting agent supplied read-only overlap/packaging inventory and a separate finite dirty-input calculation, corrected and checked by the primary agent.

open_questions.question: Can a different seven/eight-call projector pattern pass the degree-two dirty-input constraints?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The full two-sided address-twist model remains open; only this two-contribution cancellation pattern is excluded.
open_questions.first_step: Exhibit a first-order-feasible pattern with at least three contributing calls in an off-diagonal block, and test its degree-one-to-degree-two action before full synthesis.
open_questions.blocked_by: No alternative candidate is supplied; the general multi-contribution equations and native price remain unresolved.

open_questions.why_it_matters: A formal paid-call saving is not a physical supplier improvement without a complete price.

open_questions.blocked_by: This package supplies no native implementation or cost model.
